answer: An operator copying one text across 24 aliases hence pays for 24 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the knoll hash is stored at intake, the timber graph groups the endorsements and the ferrous audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
